c120ba4b1647: English has one verb, “know”. Polish splits it: wiem, ile kosztuje (information). Znać = to know someone or something (znam pana Lisa); wiedzieć = to have information.
6e85bb3133b3: English «you have» to one person → Polish Pan ma. Pan takes the 3rd person singular.
dbeec5242fa8: English «I need to» → Polish muszę or trzeba. The short „mi” never starts a sentence.
1b78b6ec2406: English «I've worked for three years» (present perfect) → Polish present tense + od trzech lat (od + genitive). The action lasts until now, so Polish uses the present.
ce4355a3003b: English «I'm waiting for the client» → Polish czekam na klienta. Czekać na + accusative.
